name: Central Coast
climate: Dry from about February to August. Heavy rain and typhoons are most likely from September to November.
days: 4 to 5 days for Hue, Hoi An, and Da Nang, plus an extra day if you add Phong Nha.
summary: A thin coast between mountains and sea: Hue’s citadel, Hoi An’s old town, Da Nang’s beach and airport, and the caves at Phong Nha.
body: This corridor is the easiest part of the classic north-to-south trip to underestimate. Hue, Da Nang, and Hoi An sit close together, but the best months are the opposite of the south. October can be lovely in Ho Chi Minh City and flooded in Hoi An.
Da Nang airport is the practical gateway. Hoi An is under an hour by road. Hue is a few hours north. Phong Nha is a separate overnight, usually from Dong Hoi or Hue.
seoDescription: Hue, Hoi An, Da Nang, and Phong Nha: when the coast is dry, and how to split the days.
